thread:
sam: Quick standup — what I did / blockers / today
sam: Did the canary cut for release-train, pushed canary to gpu-pool-2, observed ~2% error spike on reroute test.
alex: Noted. Which PRs are in the canary?
sam: PRs: #3124 (migrator), #3188 (quant-opt). One cherry-pick failed on master because of a test harness change.
maria: I can take the test fix. Will open a backport PR in ~10m.
jyoti: FYI infra rolled GPU driver on pool-2 last night; could be related.
sam: Good call — if errors persist I can roll pool-2 back to snapshot-2026-03-15.
alex: Can you paste the minimal error log?
sam: Sure:
```text
2026-03-17T10:12:03Z error: kvcache mismatch
serving: failed to allocate 512MB on device 1
trace: retrying redirect to pool-1
```
maria: I reproduced locally with the new driver. Driver says "device lost".
release-bot: Canary deployment 2468001200 -> completed (3/3 nodes). :rocket:
sam: Trying a quick swap: move PR #3188 instance to pool-1 and re-run smoke.
alex: Heads-up there's a stale cherry-pick in #3175 blocking a few backports.
sam: I'll remove #3175 from the train to unblock others. @maria can you rebase #3190 onto main after that?
maria: On it, ETA 15m. Will ping when green.
jyoti: If we need rollback, I can flip routing to the dedicated fallback cluster (latency +~40ms) to keep traffic healthy.
sam: Plan for today: finish cherry backports, monitor canary errors, coordinate rollback if driver errors hold.
alex: I'll queue a smoke on pool-1 once you confirm the swap.
sam: Confirmed — smoke job kicked. /cc @release-bot please add a note about the driver warning to canary metadata.
release-bot: Annotated: "observed driver device lost on pool-2 during canary; backout if error rate >5%".
alex: :thumbsup:
maria: Rebase + test fix pushed, opened backport branch and updated CI.
sam: Thanks — re-queuing cherry-pick now.
jyoti: I'll watch infra metrics and post alert if GPU reset rates increase.
sam: If I disappear, ping me on mobile. End of thread.
